instruction:
You are tasked with designing a verilog module that implements a 4-bit adder, with two 4-bit inputs (A and B) and a 4-bit output (S). The module should also have a carry-out output (COUT) and a carry-in input (CIN). The adder should be able to perform addition with or without carry-in.

The module should have the following interface:

```
module adder_4bit (
    input [3:0] A,
    input [3:0] B,
    input CIN,
    output [3:0] S,
    output COUT
);
```

You should implement the adder using structural verilog, using only full adders as building blocks. You may not use any pre-defined adder modules or operators.
